findings.issue: Mandated signature may be by one or more declaration authors (founders/first members of management, administration or direction), not an unrestricted external authorised signatory. Narrow Guide and ledger wording to that pool.

decision: Conditional source-fidelity acceptance after these two small formation condition clarifications; no merge approval or accountant attestation.
